purpose_context: doc-kitty is built to become a general documentation template. Its look and chrome must be a swappable, layered concern so any product line can apply its own brand without copying and diverging the toolkit. This mission builds that theme layer (default -> brand -> consumer), ships the first real brand theme end-to-end to prove the contract, and stands up the accessibility/visual test harness that keeps every theme WCAG-conformant.
purpose_tldr: Let a consumer rebrand the docsite by selecting a theme — no fork required — and ship the first brand theme (Spec Kitty).
